Renting, handled in one place.

Four things renters actually need.

Move

A plan for the whole move — tasks, dates and documents, before anything is urgent.

See more →

Move, planned by AI.

Answer a few questions and AI builds your whole move — tasks, dates and documents in the right order. Tick things off and the plan updates with you, so nothing turns urgent at the last minute. Every finished step feeds the record you carry to your next home.

← Back

Lease

Know what you're signing — every clause in plain language, before you sign.

See more →

Your lease, read by AI.

Upload the PDF and AI pulls out the numbers that matter — rent, deposit, start date, notice period — each traced to the page and clause it came from. You confirm every fact before anything else uses it, so no clause stays in legal language you can't check.

← Back

Deposit

Your Kaution, without the cash locked away. Compare deposit options in one place.

See more →

Your deposit, without the lock-up.

Compare partner-backed routes side by side — fee, coverage, eligibility — instead of handing three months' rent over in cash. You see exactly where your application stands, and the guarantee comes from a licensed partner. ßhells never holds your deposit.

← Back

Rewards

Points for the rent you already pay — to spend on things you actually want.

See more →

Rent that pays you back.

Every on-time month earns 10 points per €1 of rent, verified with your consent — never silently, never by moving your money. Streaks and tiers grow as your record does, and points turn into rewards from partners. Your record is yours: it travels with you, flat to flat.

← Back

Good behaviour should be rewarded.

The system remembers your mistakes but never your reliability. ßhells flips that — recognition for the rent you already pay, month after month.

Safe by design.

  • ✓Recognised automatically — securely, and without ever touching your bank login.
  • ✓Read-only by design — the connection can see payments, never move your money.
  • ✓Summaries, not statements — we keep the fact that rent was paid, not your balances or transactions.
  • ✓Yours to take with you — your record belongs to you, to use wherever you rent next. Not a credit score, never a judgement — just recognition for what you already do.
